newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar ends higher on soaring money rates.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar ends higher on soaring money rates.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar closed higher against its U.S. counterpart on Tuesday as soaring money rates triggered profit-taking against the recently appreciating greenback, dealers said.
The local unit closed at T$28.625 against Monday's T$28.654 finish.
Turnover through dealers was modest at US$245.5 million.
Taiwan's overnight interbank rate shot up to 7.499 percent on Monday from Saturday's 6.277 finish and rose further to 7.776 percent in late session on Tuesday.
"The Taiwan dollar may be heading for a moderate rebound if the money rates keep rising," said a dealer at a foreign bank.
"There was some profit-taking off the U.S. dollar by speculators today," she said.
The Taiwan dollar had tumbled four percent in the past week after the central bank dropped a long-time defence threshold for the currency at the T$28 level in late July.
